home.title: Aero: one prompt and it’s live, one link and it’s tested
home.description: Publish a Claude artifact, Figma prototype, Lovable app or HTML site to its own address, then send one test link. People try it on their own computer; you get the recording, transcript and summary back. Free to start.

features.title: Features: publish, test and review in one place · Aero
features.description: Every Aero feature, grouped by step: publish from one prompt, an HTML folder or a Figma link; test with one link and no software for testers; review transcripts, summaries and friction points across sessions.

pricing.title: Pricing: free to start, from $3 a month · Aero
pricing.description: Aero plans: Free, Basic $3, Solo $6 and Pro $19 a month. Recordings on every plan. 7-day free trial, no call, no contract. Compared with Maze, Lookback, Userbrain and Lyssna, per month.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Free has 3 test sessions with recordings, transcripts and summaries, and your sites stay live for 7 days.

mainEntity.name: How does the free trial work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic, Solo and Pro each start with a 7-day free trial. You can cancel before it ends.
Yes. Plans are monthly, with no contract. Cancel from your account in a couple of clicks; there is no call.

mainEntity.name: What counts as a test session?

acceptedAnswer.text: One person taking one of your tests. Today the number on your plan is a total of sessions stored, not a monthly allowance.

mainEntity.name: Why do I see a different price at checkout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aero has regional prices. The site shows USD; checkout shows the price for where you are.

mainEntity.name: What happens to a free site after 7 days?

acceptedAnswer.text: It goes offline. It keeps its address and versions, and a paid plan keeps sites live.

mainEntity.name: Do my testers pay or sign up?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They open your link and start. They never need an account.

mainEntity.name: Is there a team or yearly plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not today. Aero is priced for one person, paid monthly. There are no seats, panels or sales calls.
On Pro, your questions go to the front of the queue.

guides.title: Guides: publish and test, one job at a time · Aero
guides.description: Step-by-step guides for Aero: publish a Claude artifact, a Lovable app, a Figma prototype or an HTML folder, then test it with your own people.

publish-a-claude-artifact.title: Publish a Claude artifact to its own address · Aero
publish-a-claude-artifact.description: How to publish a Claude artifact as a real website at your own address, in one prompt or by uploading its HTML. Then test it with people you choose.

jsonld.name: Publish a Claude artifact
jsonld.description: Copy one prompt from Aero into the Claude chat where you made the artifact. Claude sends the files to Aero and it goes live at an address like yourname.aeroapp.ai. Or download the artifact as HTML and drop it into Aero.

step.name: Start a new site from a prompt
step.text: In Aero, go to Sites, New site, and pick Prompt. Give the site a name.

step.name: Copy the prompt
step.text: Aero shows one prompt with your key in it. Press Copy prompt. The key only lets this prompt publish sites in your account.

step.name: Paste it into your Claude chat
step.text: Go back to the chat where you made the artifact and paste it. Claude sends the files to Aero and replies with the address.

step.name: Open its page in Aero
step.text: Aero updates by itself when the site is live and opens its page: the address, a preview and its versions.

mainEntity.name: Does my artifact stay on claude.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Aero publishes a copy at its own address. Your chat and the artifact in Claude don’t change.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my own domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on Solo and up. Every site also has an aeroapp.ai address, and on Basic and up you choose its name.
Ask Claude for the change in the same chat, then use the prompt again. Aero keeps every version, so you can roll back.
Add a password on Basic and up, so only people you give it to can open it.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with ChatGPT too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The same prompt works in the ChatGPT chat where you built it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a free site stay live?

acceptedAnswer.text: 7 days. Paid plans keep it live; they start at $3 a month with a 7-day free trial.
